name: Gästehaus Schwaighofer
beschreibung: The Gästehaus Schwaighofer is situated in Niederndorf in the Tyrolean Unterland, close to the German border. The property is an authentic inn featuring an adjoining restaurant known primarily for serving hearty traditional snacks and cold platters (Brotzeit). Guest rooms are well appointed with a private bathroom, toilet, and satellite TV. Its setting on the edge of Niederndorf offers a peaceful, rural retreat. In summer, scenic hiking trails throughout the Kaisergebirge mountains beckon outdoor enthusiasts. In winter, nearby ski resorts and cross-country ski trails provide ample recreation. The guesthouse also features private parking and a children's playground.
